questions.question_text: What is the role of curiosity in developing a research mindset as described in the chapter?

options.text: To accept information without questioning it
To spark interest and ask specific, actionable questions that guide investigation
To focus only on topics already known to you
To avoid digging deeper into complex issues

correct_answer.text: To spark interest and ask specific, actionable questions that guide investigation

questions.question_text: How does critical thinking help in research according to the chapter?

options.text: By encouraging you to believe every claim you read online
By helping you question information, analyze its credibility, and decide if it’s trustworthy
By limiting your research to only one source of information
By ignoring data that doesn’t match your opinion

correct_answer.text: By helping you question information, analyze its credibility, and decide if it’s trustworthy

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a characteristic of a reliable source as mentioned in the chapter?

options.text: It comes from a random blog with no author or evidence
It is backed by evidence and comes from credible organizations like government or educational websites
It is full of advertisements and clickbait headlines
It provides outdated information without any references

correct_answer.text: It is backed by evidence and comes from credible organizations like government or educational websites

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of setting research goals and objectives in the research process?

options.text: To make research more confusing and time-consuming
To provide a clear roadmap with a big-picture goal and specific steps to stay focused
To avoid planning and randomly collect information
To focus only on small details without a larger purpose

correct_answer.text: To provide a clear roadmap with a big-picture goal and specific steps to stay focused
